name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.full_invariant
type_text:
∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
      (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
        ∀ (a : ℕ),
          have s := outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer a;
          s.remaining.Nodup ∧
            (∀ b ∈ s.remaining, b < labels.length) ∧
              start ≤ s.clock ∧
                s.sum + (List.map (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.contribution f labels x) s.remaining).sum =
                    (List.map (fun i => gradient (f i) x) labels).sum ∧
                  (s.remaining ≠ [] →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.legalRequest τ { clock := s.clock, pending := s.pending }) ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin n) (job : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m),
                        s.pending i = some job → job.kind = Sum.inl x ∧ job.id < s.nextID) ∧
                      ∀ (i i' : Fin n) (job job' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m),
                        s.pending i = some job → s.pending i' = some job' → job.id = job'.id → i = i'
